meta.task_verbatim: Design a battery for extreme-cold environment equipment: 1C discharge capacity retention >= 95% at -20C, energy density >= 327.18 Wh/kg, volumetric energy density >= 880 Wh/L.
meta.start_stage_basis: objective names no new materials/additives/electrolyte chemistry; it is a cell-performance design task (extreme-cold scenario protocol lowT_discharge lives at Stage 3). Electrolyte formulation and system switch remain available via widest degree-of-freedom interpretation; material-bottleneck escalation to Stage 2 allowed if the gap is a transport/material-property limit.
meta.base_params_basis: task text names no electrode system -> deterministic default Chen2020 per anchor table (with record). Electrode system is an adjustable freedom (widest interpretation), so system candidates (e.g. OKane2022) may be proposed if baseline ED/VED is insufficient.

freedoms.electrode_system: adjustable (widest interpretation; task text silent; baseline = Chen2020 default)
freedoms.electrolyte_formulation: adjustable (widest interpretation; task text silent; sigma/t+/D transport parameter overrides via parameter bridge)
freedoms.electrode_modification: adjustable (widest interpretation; task text silent; coating/doping via SEI parameter bridge)
freedoms.cell_architecture: adjustable (widest interpretation; task text silent; thickness/porosity/N-P/separator/collector/particle size)
freedoms.thermal_management: adjustable (widest interpretation; task text silent; cooling coefficient h)

meta.lowT_retention_definition: fraction = capacity_ah(lowT_discharge @253.15K, 1C) / capacity_ah(1C_discharge @298.15K, 1C); task text '95%' = 0.95; mechanically computed from the two run-pyamm outputs and written to a derived JSON passed to log-evaluate
meta.defaults_record: T_max_K max 333.15 K (=60 C red line, protocol Stage-4 safety default) and plated=false (no Li plating during 4C charge at 45 C) are protocol safety defaults because the task text is silent on safety metrics. stage1 elimination lines (max_energy_ev 0.0 eV, max_homo_ev -6.0 eV) are protocol funnel defaults, pre-registered in case of Stage-2 molecular escalation.
meta.no_durability_metric: task text has no cycle-life/aging metric -> aging protocol not required by criteria

objective_breakdown: Three task metrics + protocol safety defaults. Binding constraint: -20C 1C retention >=0.95 (electrolyte transport + CT kinetics dominate cold polarization). ED>=327.18 Wh/kg moderate (contract baseline est ~410-420). VED>=880 Wh/L borderline (baseline est ~860-900; thin separator/collectors raise it). Trade-offs: lowT retention vs electrode thickness (ED/VED), and cooling h (low h self-heats at -20C but raises 4C/45C T_max).
candidate_strategy: R1 baseline Chen2020 (anchor-verified pure-graphite negative) 1C+lowT+calc-energy with opening ceiling assessment; R2-R3 electrolyte formulation props (flat kappa 0.8/1.1 S/m marked estimate, D_e flat, t+ 0.5/0.6 LiFSI-class); R3-R5 architecture variants (thinner electrodes 50/60um, smaller particles 2.5/3um, separator 12->8um, collectors 16/12->10/8um); R6-R7 best combination DFN refinement; R8 Stage 4 safety; system switch to OKane2022 only if ED/VED insufficient or three-strike questioning points there.
budget_allocation: R1 baseline+ceiling; R2-R3 electrolyte screen; R3-R5 architecture screen; R6-R7 refinement; R8 safety; closing (endorse-skip real_compute=false, render, deliverables).
risk_and_fallback: Risks: VED borderline -> thin sep/collectors; lowT retention unattainable -> particle-size reduction (j0 not an allowed lever) then three-strike questioning (system assumption, boundary assumption incl. scalar-kappa idealization, metric assumption) with honest negative-result quantification; SPMe/DFN divergence at 253K -> DFN certifies; scalar kappa override is T-independent (optimistic vs real electrolytes) - labeled estimate, literature: LiFSI/ester best-case kappa(-20C)~0.3-0.6 S/m.

detail: start_stage=3: no molecular screening this case; materials use system baseline. Base=Chen2020 chosen by anchor table (task text names no electrode system -> deterministic default) and verified by parameter dump: pure-graphite negative (density 1657 kg/m3, max conc 33133 mol/m3, no SiOx keys), NMC811 positive (63104 mol/m3), SEI-capable (SEI kinetic rate constant 1e-12). Props source: baseline (parameter-set literature values).

ceiling_assessment.limit_estimate: VED ceiling ~900-930 Wh/L (thin CC+separator and thicker electrodes under same capacity); ED ceiling ~420+ Wh/kg; lowT retention ceiling ~0.99 (self-heating dominated; electrolyte transport is not the binding loss at 1C in this parameterization)
ceiling_assessment.conclusion: objective (ED>=327.18, VED>=880, retention>=0.95) lies inside the existing system's architecture+formulation ceiling -> no Stage-2 material escalation required; proceed with cell-architecture design at Stage 3
ceiling_assessment.test_condition_note: run-pyamm lowT_discharge sets Ambient temperature to 253.15 K but leaves Initial temperature [K] at the parameter-set default 298.15 K (warm start). The -20C retention metric uses a cold-soaked start (Initial temperature [K]=253.15) as a test-condition definition (not a design lever); both conditions measured: warm-start 0.9943, cold-soak 0.9942 (DFN).

reason: real_compute=false (entry-0 meta, headless default); start_stage=3 case has no molecular candidates, so no run-orca/run-md true-compute endorsement runs were executed. No DFT/MD values fabricated. The finalist's electrolyte-transport values (kappa 1.1 S/m flat, D_e 3e-10 m2/s flat, t+ 0.6) are design-target overrides entered via the parameter bridge (LHCE-class profile), NOT true-compute endorsed; this is recorded as an estimate-grade caveat in the final recommendation.

recommendation: Lead design T2 (Chen2020 base, all values sourced from tool outputs): thin current collectors 10/8 um + separator 10 um + negative particle radius 2.5 um; electrolyte design-target transport profile kappa=1.1 S/m flat, D_e=3e-10 m2/s flat, t+=0.6 (LHCE/LiFSI-class idealization); immersion cooling h=80 W/m2/K. Measured: ED 471.55 Wh/kg >= 327.18 (cell/r6_t2_energy.json), VED 925.77 Wh/L >= 880, lowT_retention 0.99267 >= 0.95 (cold-soak 253.15 K with self-heating removed by h=80, cell stayed at ~256 K; cell/r6_t2_retention.json), 1C T_max 299.6 K, 4C/45C safety exam T_max 327.7 K <= 333.15 K and anode potential min +0.0205 V -> plated=false (cell/r6_t2_4c45C_dfn.json, DFN). Caveats: (1) flat-transport profile is optimistic at -20 C (real LHCE kappa ~0.3 S/m would add ohmic loss; retention margin is 4.27 pt -> estimate-grade, recommend experimental confirmation); (2) h=80 assumes active immersion cooling; (3) particle 2.5 um is fine-fraction graphite (manufacturing feasibility by domain experience).
